_comment: The film's timing, in one place, because two things need it: jadwal.ts
builds the cut from it, and bake_musik.py uses it to automate the music
bed offline. Keeping it here rather than in either of them is what stops
the score's duck drifting away from the scene it is meant to duck under.
durasi values are ffprobe measurements of the narration mp3s, in seconds.
